jobs.occupation: Air Freight Pricing Specialist (f/m/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung)
jobs.description:
Welcome to Rhenus!

The Rhenus Group is one of the leading global logistics service providers. Throughout the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies across a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of industry developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.

What you can expect:

- In this position, you will receive, review and process ad-hoc pricing requests from both the global network and own-controlled customers - including the clarification of customer requirements, if needed.
- In addition, you will work closely with local operations and sales to understand customer needs, apply pricing according to local price sensitivity, and support the execution of margin and pricing strategies.
- You will foster exchange with the Airfreight Pricing & Procurement Team (e.g., for shipment solutions over 1.5 tons) and the Gateway Team in Frankfurt to develop competitive and operationally feasible solutions.
- Furthermore, you will ensure thorough documentation of all quotations and provide insightful reporting to local P&L responsible parties, local sales, the airfreight product team, and the Gateway.
- Last but not least, you will be responsible for the follow-up on all provided spot quotations and related inquiries - ensuring feedback is received, success rates are monitored through standard reporting, and coordination with the Commercial Team is maintained. You will also follow customer-specific pricing instructions precisely.

What you bring:

- You have already gained previous experience in airfreight operations or sales, providing a solid foundation in industry processes and commercial dynamics.
- A self-reliant working style combined with the ability to perform well under pressure in time-sensitive environments is one of your key strengths.
- You have a confident and professional demeanor in negotiations and in communication with both customers and suppliers.
- Naturally, you bring a strong numerical understanding and a sharp eye for detail, supporting accurate and data-driven decision-making.
- Business fluency in English, along with strong verbal and written communication skills, round off your profile.

Your benefits:

- Cafeteria: Fuel your day with nutritious meals at our on-site cafeteria.
- Continuous Training: Sharpen your skills and advance your expertise with our professional development programs.
- Exclusive Discounts: Benefit from attractive employee discounts on different products and services.
- Flexible Working Times: We offer flexible schedules to suit your lifestyle and personal commitments.
- Free Parking: No one likes to start their day hunting for a spot - we've got guaranteed free parking spaces for everyone.
- Monthly Gift Vouchers: Enjoy an extra amount each month for fuel, groceries, or entertainment.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral researcher in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d) (Biophysiker/in)
jobs.description:
A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Your roles:

- Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
- Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
- Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
- Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
- Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
- Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

Your profile:

- PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
- Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
- Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
- Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
- Very good communication skills in English.

We offer:

- Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
- An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
- State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
- Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
- A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
- A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
- Transparent opportunities for career development.
- Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
- A family-friendly working place.
- A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.

Interested?

We look forward to your application! Please upload your CV and motivation letter, by October 15th, 2026 via the online application system. For further information on this position, please contact INM Scientific Director and Head of the Research Department Dynamic Biomaterials Prof. Dr. Aránzazu del Campo (aranzazu.delcampo@leibniz-inm.de ).

The INM practices an open and appreciative corporate culture in which the existing diversity is promoted and lived. The institute is an equal opportunity employer with a certified family-friendly policy, and it provides offers for a better work-life balance, flextime, and mobile working. We promote professional opportunities for women and strongly encourage them to apply. Full time jobs can be generally divided. People with disabilities are expressly encouraged to apply and will be given priority if equally qualified.

Process Operator (f/m/d)

Place of work: Production site, near Chemnitz, Germany
Start date: ASAP
Contract type: Full-time

About us

We’re on a mission to revolutionize how the world produces protein and we’re just getting started.

Pacifico is a Leipzig-based biotech company producing the world’s most cost-competitive texturized protein through fermentation. Our technology makes sustainable, high-quality protein cheaper than conventional meat production – not just better for the planet, but better for you.

Our production site near Chemnitz is where science meets scale: industrial fermentation systems, food-grade processing lines, and a team that moves fast. We’re now looking for a Process Operator (f/m/d) to support the day-to-day facility operations at our production site.

The role

In this role, you will support the operations of our fermentation facility and all related processing steps. You will work closely with a Senior Process Lead and will be trained on our equipment, processes, and quality standards.

The role is strongly hands-on and operational, with a focus on running equipment, preparing materials, and supporting production. Working hours are initially within typical daytime working hours; as production scales, openness to late and occasional weekend shifts is valued.

Your main tasks

- Preparation of fermentation media (weighing, mixing, heating, handling raw materials)
- Operating fermentation tanks and auxiliary equipment
- Supporting downstream processing (emptying tanks, handling and processing biomass)
- Operating our food processing line and its associated equipment
- Monitoring basic process parameters (e.g. temperature, time, filling levels)
- Cleaning and sanitising equipment (CIP systems and manual cleaning)
- Maintaining cleanliness, order, and safety in the facility
- Documenting basic production activities and flagging issues when they arise

Your profile

- Practical experience in food & beverage or similar manufacturing environments
- Comfortable working in a production setting with physical tasks and machinery
- Careful, reliable, and quality-oriented working style
- Interest in food production and fermentation processes
- Ability to work well in a small team and communicate clearly on the shop floor
- Basic working knowledge of English

Nice to have

- Experience in a brewery, dairy or fermentation-based production
- Technical or vocational training in a relevant field
- Familiarity with hygiene standards and food safety practices
- Experience with CIP systems or industrial cleaning routines
- Basic working knowledge of German

What we offer

- A full-time role with clear responsibilities and growth opportunities
- 28 days of paid holiday per year
- Subsidy for the Germany Ticket (“Deutschland-Ticket”)
- Hands-on training and close collaboration with experienced colleagues

How to apply

A short CV/brief overview of your previous work experience is sufficient.

• Contributing to the establishment, optimization and
documentation of biological test systems and preclinical evaluation protocols
• Performing in vitro studies, including stability, binding and cellular uptake assays as well as studies using models of the blood-brain-barrier
• Preclinical evaluation of tracer candidates in suitable in vivo models, including support of small-animal imaging studies
• Performing and analyzing ex vivo studies, e.g., autoradiography, biodistribution studies and complementary tissue analyses
• Quantitative analysis of biological and imaging data and
interpretation of results in close interaction with the other project partners
• Evaluation, documentation, and scientific presentation of experimental results in project reports, publications, and presentations

Your profile
• Completed university degree and Ph.D. in biology, life sciences, neuroscience, biochemistry, pharmacy or a related field
• Experience in preclinical imaging (e.g. small animal PET, SPECT, MRI, CT)
• Experience with animal models and experimental animal work is advantageous (FELASA-B or EU functions A, C, D)
• Experience with cell culture, in vitro assays, autoradiography, ex vivo analyses and BBB models is desirable
• Interest in radiopharmaceutical tracer development, molecular imaging and translational research
• Willingness to work with unsealed radioactive substances and to become familiar with radiation protection-related workflows
• Willingness to conduct biological and preclinical experiments within an interdisciplinary team
• Good written and spoken English skills
• Structured, independent and conscientious working style
• Ability to work in a team, strong communication skills and interest in interdisciplinary collaboration between chemistry, radiochemistry, biology, medicine and imaging

Our offer
• Everything but ordinary: You can expect a secure job in a challenging, innovative environment – including company pension schemes and regular working hours without business trips.
• Work-life balance: Whether full-time or part-time, with or without children – with numerous support options, we will find the right path together.
• Team spirit in R(h)ine culture: You will be warmly welcomed by an interdisciplinary team that values mutual respect and helpfulness.
• Strong perspectives: We offer extensive training opportunities – so you can continuously grow and set new goals.

Your future with us
We are one of the leading university hospitals in Germany and network research, teaching and health care at the highest level. That's why many things are a lot bigger for us: the spectrum of exciting development opportunities. The limitless openness with which specialists from all over the world work together here. Or our commitment as an employer to support all employees as best we can in reconciling their job with their goals and life situations.
This is the University Hospital of Cologne: Everything but ordinary.

Your future in detail
The Institute of Radiochemistry and Experimental Molecular Imaging (IREMB) is seeking a postdoctoral researcher for a translational research project in the field of radiopharmaceutical tracer development and molecular imaging. The postdoc position will initially be embedded for one year in the internationally funded IMAGESTRO project. There is an option of extension for another year. The focus of the work will be on the biological validation of newly developed PET or SPECT radiotracers.
The IMAGESTRO project aims to develop novel 18F-labeled PET tracers for the non-invasive imaging of estrogen receptors in the brain, to characterize them preclinically, and to translate them into human applications. The project focuses on the organic synthesis of suitable precursor and reference compounds, the development and optimization
of radiofluorination strategies, and the comprehensive analytical and preclinical characterization of the resulting radiotracers. The work will be carried out in close cooperation between the University Hospital Cologne and Forschungszentrum Jülich and offers an interdisciplinary research environment at the interface of organic chemistry, radiochemistry, radiopharmacy, molecular imaging, biology and neuroscience.

jobs.description:
Overview  

 
At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.  

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams. 
 
We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you. 

 

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact. 

 

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery. 

‎

About the opportunity

As (Senior) Manager Direct Tax Compliance & Processes, you will act as a trusted business partner to management, driving efficiency and effectiveness across tax compliance, accounting, and reporting activities. You will play a key role in enhancing QIAGEN's tax compliance and governance framework, supporting our tax compliance insourcing strategy, and advancing tax quality and change management initiatives. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders while contributing to tax reporting, compliance, process optimization, and strategic tax projects across the DACH region.

Your tasks
* Further develop and enhance the Tax Compliance Management System while proactively supporting tax governance, tax quality, and change management initiatives.
* Support annual tax reporting at both legal entity and group level, including the calculation of tax positions and preparation of tax-related disclosures under US GAAP and local GAAP requirements.
* Manage direct tax return and compliance processes in collaboration with external advisors across the DACH region.
* Oversee additional tax compliance obligations within the DACH region and maintain the tax compliance calendar.
* Manage inbound and outbound withholding tax matters, including reporting and filing requirements, while identifying and implementing process improvements.
* Serve as a key business partner for Accounting, Treasury, Legal, Operations, and other internal stakeholders on tax-related matters.
* Support tax audits, tax planning activities, and corporate tax restructuring projects.

Your profile
* University degree in Business Administration, Economics (with a focus on Tax and/or Accounting), Tax Administration (Finanzwirt) or a comparable qualification.
* At least 5 years of relevant professional experience gained within an international advisory firm (e.g., Big 4) and/or the tax function of a multinational organization.
* Strong understanding of direct tax compliance, tax accounting, and tax reporting requirements.
* Proven ability to work independently with a high level of accuracy, diligence, and quality awareness.
* Experience with Microsoft Office applications as well as tax and ERP systems such as DATEV and SAP.
* Professional proficiency in English and German with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Collaborative team player with strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

What we offer  

 

* Bonus/Commission  

* Local benefits   

* Referral Program  

* Volunteer Day  

* Internal Academy (QIALearn)   

* Employee Assistance Program   

* Hybrid work (conditional to your role) 

 

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.   

 

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

jobs.description:
What to Expect

In this role you’ll support the design, construction, launch, and transfer of geartrain manufacturing lines and equipment used in Optimus Actuators. This role will prioritize successful design and launch of production line while maintaining maximum efficiency, production volume, and safety while validating performance and fully documenting all aspects of the project for handover to sustaining operations.  The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise in high-volume geartrain manufacturing lines and the successful introduction of new technologies to mass production line. They must demonstrate experience translating manufacturing requirements into efficient, detailed production line designs that are robust and practical to implement . In this position, you will take ownership of production line creation of specialized equipment from concept through line launch completion—defining performance requirements, running process flow simulations as needed to validate solutions grounded in first principles, and leading commissioning through final validation.

What You’ll Do

- Use CAD software and simulation tools (e.g., AutoCAD, FactoryCAD, or similar) to create 2D/3D models, floor plans, and detailed drawings that support both main production line and also supporting areas within Geartrain Manufacturing Scope
- Work with factory simulation/modeling teams to develop flow manufacturing constraints for new equipment development such as aisle sizing, incoming raw materials to the cell and work in progress areas between cells
- Install, commission, integrate and troubleshoot new equipment and tooling and support setup for manufacturing, including machines, peripheral equipment, tools, and automation systems
- Oversee the handover of commissioned lines to production teams, including operator training, documentation of procedures and manufacturing BOM, and resolution of issues during line launch
- Contribute to R&D efforts in equipment design and process development by integrating layout considerations, material flow, and facility requirements early in the innovation cycle to enable scalable and efficient manufacturing solutions
- Design and develop detailed cell and production line layouts for each gearbox, including placement of machinery and their integration to the mainline, workstations, material flow paths, utilities, and storage areas to optimize production processes and efficiency
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Factory, Infrastructure, Material Flow, Design, Manufacturing Eng., EHS personnel, and project&program leads) to integrate layouts into main factory design
- Ensure compliance with Tesla safety regulations, ergonomic standards, and lean manufacturing principles while evaluating new equipment and processes from R&D initiatives
- Evaluate data on production performance, material handling, and space utilization to recommend layout improvements that align with ongoing R&D advancements in equipment and manufacturing processes
- Design custom fixtures, tooling, and other structures that would be used in manufacturing cells as needed, providing detailed build to print models/drawings for fabrication

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Industrial Engineering or a related field (advanced degree or relevant certifications are a plus), or equivalent industry experience and evidence of exceptional ability
- Several years of experience in manufacturing or industrial engineering, with hands-on involvement in factory/plant layout projects
- Proficiency in layout design software, process simulation tools, and data analysis
- Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, material flow, ergonomics, and facility safety standards
- Experience designing layouts, mechanical equipment, fixturing, and tooling

The Tesla Robotics Team designs and builds humanoid bi-pedal robots (Optimus) to perform tasks that are boring, repetitive, and dangerous for humans. - Collaborate with Test Engineering to design and validate experiments, correlate test data with simulations, and enhance predictive modeling capabilities

- Expertise in building high-fidelity FE models at component, sub-system, and full-system levels
- Proficiency in linear and non-linear static, dynamic and modal simulations and experience developing multi-physics simulation workflows (e.g., thermal-mechanical, mechanical-electrical)
